name: Xerath
title: the Magus Ascendant

Q.name: Arcanopulse
Q.description: Begin Charging: Xerath begins charging an arcane beam, Slowing himself gradually up to 50%. Release: Xerath fires the beam, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.9×AP magic damage. The range increases with time charged.
Q.summary: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

W.name: Eye of Destruction
W.description: Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing 50/85/120/155/190 + 0.65×AP magic damage and Slowing them by 25% for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the center take (50/85/120/155/190 + 0.65×AP) × 1.667 magic damage instead and are Slowed by 60/65/70/75/80%, decaying over 2.5 seconds.
W.summary: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

E.name: Shocking Orb
E.description: Xerath fires an orb of raw magic, Stunning the first enemy hit for up to 2.25 seconds based on distance travelled, and dealing 70/100/130/160/190 + 0.45×AP magic damage.
E.summary: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

R.name: Rite of the Arcane
R.description: Xerath ascends to his true form and channels for 10 seconds. During this time he may Recast up to 4/5/6 times. Recast: Xerath launches a magical artillery, dealing 170/220/270 + 0.45×AP magic damage. For each champion hit, the artillery deals an additional 20/25/30 + 0.05×AP magic damage.
R.summary: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

Passive.name: Mana Surge
Passive.description: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.
Passive.summary: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Long-range artillery mage who chips enemies from far away with Q and W. Wins lane through poke and picks off low targets with E stun and R.
strengths: Longest basic-ability range among mages: Q charges into huge range
W center hit slows hard and deals bonus damage
E stun scales with distance (up to 2.25 s)
R 'Rite of the Arcane' finishes low targets across the map
Passive restores mana on attacks, so he can poke for a long time
weaknesses: No dash or self-peel beyond E: very vulnerable to engage and dive
Q charging slows himself, making him easy to catch while charging
Weak against mobile champions who dodge skillshots
Low damage up close and against all-ins

curve.items: strong – Luden's/Malignance, Lost Chapter for mana

profile.curveNote: Q poke from level 1, but the threatening combo needs E (stun) to land W center.
profile.waveClear: good – Q line and W area from range

Q.notes: Charged beam; slows himself while charging. Not a missile.

W.notes: Delayed circle; center takes 1.667× damage and a bigger slow.

E.notes: Orb stun, longer the farther it travels (up to 2.25 s). Blockable.

R.notes: Channel up to 4/5/6 long-range artillery shots; he can't move while channelling.

profile.windowAgainst: E on cooldown (11–13 s) or while charging Q/channelling R: engage then.
checks: Whether projectile blocks stop R shots (they're delayed ground blasts, likely not).
